release_title: TikTok Japanese settings v1.0.0 / Hiro Morphe Patches v1.0.279
summary: icysymmetra版TikTokパッチ v0.9.0-dev.1が追加するMetra設定の2,181項目に日本語辞書を追加します。「TikTok設定を日本語化」を上流のSettingsと一緒に選択すると、日本語の端末／アプリ設定で表示します。既定では未選択です。国名・変更履歴・ライセンス原文・診断の生データは対象外。TikTok 47.4.3実APK・端末動作は未確認。
validation_basis: Complete 2,181-entry English/Japanese catalog key, placeholder and newline audit; bounded 37-chunk initializer generation; host locale/fallback/format checks using the actual upstream localization source; registry selftest against the real published Metra extension DEX; 12 synthetic APK cases covering standalone/aggregate MPP, both TikTok packages, and existing-extension/import-first/Japanese-first order. Missing-extension rejection and repeat application are checked. The entire previous bundle loader is preserved semantically and every existing non-manifest/non-loader-DEX resource is byte-identical. Two fresh local and two fresh CI builds must produce identical MPP and QA bytes. Original TikTok APK, physical device, and all 123 patches together are not tested.
local_expected_host: PASS localization host: 2181 entries through real upstream L10n; locale order/cache; null/styled/unknown fallback; formatting/plurals; assertions=4392
